name: PostEx HR Portal
description: Production-grade enterprise HR onboarding and governance portal featuring 3-layer authorization (Role defaults, User overrides with mandatory justifications, and Zonal RLS), Phase 6 Super Admin portal with global metrics, attention summary, Organization CRUD, and non-overrideable Audit Trails; plus Phase 7 production integrations for Pakistan-optimized SMS/OTP (Infobip, Twilio, Jazz), transactional email (AWS SES, SendGrid, Mailgun), private encrypted Supabase storage with short-lived HMAC signed URLs, and WhatsApp Business Cloud API.
